"''The point ssstands.|[[Sskeer]] and Terec|}} The '''Suolriep sector''', also known as [[sector]] '''J-19''', was a sector in [[the galaxy]]. It was full of barren [[planet]]s''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' and contained the [[Saleucami system]]. By the [[time]] of a [[Nihil]] [[Attack in the Kazlin system|attack]] on a [[Hutt]] [[starship]] in the [[Kazlin system]][[The High Republic (2021) 2|''The High Republic'' (2021) 2]] in [[232 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[The High Republic (2021) 2|''The High Republic'' 2]] to [[232 BBY]]. the [[sector]] was part of the [[Galactic Frontier]] and had only been aligned with the [[Galactic Republic]] for a few [[Standard month|months]], which the [[Jedi]] [[Terec]] speculated was the reason the [[Hutt Clan|Hutt]] ship had been traveling there despite a Republic embargo on trade with the clans. During the [[Clone Wars]], several battles took place in the sector: the [[capture of Eeth Koth]] and subsequent [[Battle of Saleucami]], as well as the [[Siege of Saleucami]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]]. In the first days of the [[Galactic Empire]], the fugitive [[Clone Force 99]] set a course for the sector after [[Escape from Kamino|escaping]] [[Kamino]], as they knew someone there, [[Cut Lawquane]], who could potentially help them.{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} {{Loc-stub}} ==Appearances== *[[The High Republic (2021) 2|''The High Republic'' (2021) 2]] *{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}} {{1stID|sector J-19}} *{{TCW|The Deserter}} *{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}} {{Hologram}} *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} {{Mo}} *{{TBB|Cut and Run}} *{{TBB|The Solitary Clone}} *[[Obi-Wan 4|''Obi-Wan'' 4]] {{Flash}} *[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] {{Ab|Aftermath (audiobook)}} *''[[Hunters: Battle for the Arena]]'' {{Ab|Hunters: Battle for the Arena (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' {{1stID|Suolriep sector}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|48|Databank A-Z}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/aftermath-episode-guide|text="Aftermath" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/cut-and-run-episode-guide|text="Cut and Run" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Din Djarin and Other Characters of the Underworld}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Sector Suolriep |fr=Secteur Suolriep |ja=サオルリープ宙域 |ka=სუოლრიპის სექტორი |pl=Sektor Suolriep }} [[Category:Galactic Frontier sectors]] [[Category:Sectors of the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Sectors of the Slice]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Suolriep sector locations]] }}
